title: ORDER-D621-O22-C4B: owner-selected Rasson MODEL nose radius; Diamond cage foot and lean retained
principle: Values are measured in process from the archived renderer's fresh scene dumps. No result-file input, missing-value pass, threshold override or tolerance amendment. C4B owner option b binds row e to the existing Rasson CU-09 MODEL scalar receipt; actual OURS B fits are measured independently. Exact B ladders still decide f/j against the Diamond cage, with unchanged PREP secondary columns.
decision: C4B owner option b adopts only the unscaled Rasson OX CU-09 MODEL nose radius, through the committed leaf and confirmed station receipt. The previous Diamond control-cage radius is historical TESSELLATION. R1 back lean and R3 foot retain C2 TESSELLATION, with no new ruling; R4/R5, the crease and every kernel datum remain unchanged.
numeric_provenance: Targets below carry their own tag. Every threshold and expected count is DERIVED verbatim from ORDER-D621-O22 section 4, not fitted to this implementation. Sampling is TESSELLATION as fixed by the PREP reader. Diagnostic floating-point guards are CLEARANCE, not verdict tolerances.

measurement_method.ruling: ORDER-D621-O22-C4B, owner option b, 2026-09-10: row e compares all 144 resolved OURS B nose fits with the unscaled, receipt-bound Rasson CU-09 MODEL scalar. Diamond cage radius fits remain non-deciding diagnostics. The radius bar, all sampling counts, f/j instruments, other targets and WASM pin are unchanged.
measurement_method.sectioner: The same section_dz / objlib.section triangle-plane intersections and exact segment crossings for MODEL and OURS, at the same six-rail, eight-station ordinal grid with the unchanged end margin.
measurement_method.radius_fit: OURS retains the original B centered least-squares fit on actual section vertices within geometry-derived shoulder support. The target is the confirmed Rasson CU-09 scalar at the pinned commit, from its existing 32-station replication receipt; Rasson geometry is not remeasured. Diamond cage face-tangent and B apex fits are recorded only as historical diagnostics.
measurement_method.model_reference: The Diamond cage still supplies the unchanged exact-B f/j comparison and other cage diagnostics on the six-rail/eight-station grid. The separately cited Rasson MODEL receipt decides only e; no Diamond cage radius or nominal renderer value substitutes for it.
measurement_method.secondary: PREP one-mm chord radii and windowed ladders remain per station and beside e/f/j, explicitly non-deciding. Historical PREP e keeps its 1.2 mm reference solely to preserve the prior secondary column; h retains its standing trace method with the new MODEL-derived entry radius.
measurement_method.reason: The one-mm depth band extends beyond the nose facets/arc into the sloping tangent faces, so its vertical span is not a circular chord; the inverse-chord formula over-read the MODEL itself as 1.18 mm as well as biasing OURS upward.
measurement_method.identifiability: Every OURS radius fit must resolve with finite support. Missing, disconnected, collinear, flat-apex or ambiguous-shoulder sections are UNRESOLVED. An unresolved fit contributes a non-passing sample; no nominal fill, dropped station or tolerance change. Rasson leaf/receipt, all three CU-11 leaves, the law target and the generated served leaf must bind exactly.
measurement_method.radius_derivation: With inward unit face normals N and offsets k, a tangent circle center satisfies N*C=k+r, hence C=C0+r*v. For each actual facet vertex P_i, the residual |P_i-C|^2-r^2 is quadratic in r. Minimize the sum of squared residuals by evaluating all positive real roots of its cubic derivative. Report radius spread across 48 stations and per-station radial rms/tangency error; no arbitrary triangle-edge crossing is a facet vertex.

secondary_radius_reference_mm.source: Historical O22 PREP column reference only; never a deciding constant.

model_tessellation_note.source: The existing 24 nose arc rows are unchanged. C4B changes only their radius to the owner-selected, unscaled Rasson CU-09 value; the old Diamond cage face-tangent radius remains a non-deciding historical diagnostic.

decision_history.decision: R1 = MODEL 14.58 degrees, accepted and owner-overridable; RKC/bradsh98 via AZB 465370 remains community tier, not MFR. R2 = MODEL facet-aware face-tangent radius, measured 0.796881 mm and rounded to 0.80 mm; the order's 1.2 was a chord over-read. The earlier ~0.5 / chord-equivalent ~0.53 proposal is retained as a different convention, not relabelled as this tangent read. Owner may overrule. R3/R4/R5 and every kernel datum remain unchanged.

measurement_method.ruling: ORDER-D621-O22-FIX1 plus maintainer addendum 2026-09-09: MODEL row-e target is the circle tangent to both adjoining faces fitted through the actual facet vertices; OURS keeps the B apex circle fit. R2 follows the 48 fresh MODEL reads. The +/-0.3 mm bar, counts, other ordered dimensions and WASM pin stay unchanged. Exact B intersections continue to decide f/j.
measurement_method.sectioner: The same section_dz / objlib.section triangle-plane intersections and exact segment crossings for MODEL and OURS, at the same six-rail, eight-station ordinal grid with the unchanged end margin.
measurement_method.radius_fit: Exact closed triangle sections on both sides. Coordinate-precision simplification removes collinear triangle splits; each shoulder is located by the largest adjacent facet-length increase. MODEL fits a circle tangent to the two adjoining face lines through the nose-facet vertices. OURS uses the original B centered least-squares circle fit on raw section vertices at depths no greater than the smaller of its two measured shoulder depths. This support is geometry-derived, not target-derived. MODEL's B apex fit is also recorded diagnostically and can be UNRESOLVED.
measurement_method.model_reference: Only one purchased 8-ft model exists: its same 48 physical sections are evaluated for each of the three size comparisons, never scaled or presented as three independent models; the deciding MODEL ladder comparison remains 8-ft only.
measurement_method.secondary: PREP one-mm chord radii and windowed ladders remain per station and beside e/f/j, explicitly non-deciding. Historical PREP e keeps its 1.2 mm reference solely to preserve the prior secondary column; h retains its standing trace method with the new MODEL-derived entry radius.
measurement_method.reason: The one-mm depth band extends beyond the nose facets/arc into the sloping tangent faces, so its vertical span is not a circular chord; the inverse-chord formula over-read the MODEL itself as 1.18 mm as well as biasing OURS upward.
measurement_method.identifiability: A missing, disconnected, literal flat-apex, collinear or ambiguous-shoulder section is UNRESOLVED. In particular a circle fit on 2-4 collinear vertices is UNRESOLVED by construction. If either the MODEL tangent fit or OURS B fit is unresolved, that station has null error and row e cannot pass. No dropping pairs or nominal substitution.
measurement_method.radius_derivation: With inward unit face normals N and offsets k, a tangent circle center satisfies N*C=k+r, hence C=C0+r*v. For each actual facet vertex P_i, the residual |P_i-C|^2-r^2 is quadratic in r. Minimize the sum of squared residuals by evaluating all positive real roots of its cubic derivative. Report radius spread across 48 stations and per-station radial rms/tangency error; no arbitrary triangle-edge crossing is a facet vertex.

model_tessellation_note.source: The existing NA=24 nose arc rows are unchanged. A proposed 0.5 mm arc would have roughly 0.03 mm of arc per row at this angular span: the crisp MODEL edge is not evidence of a 1.2 mm circle. The actual constrained tangent fit is recorded separately and is near the refuters' 0.81 mm facet fit.
